# Multi-Distance fNIRS Dataset Generated During Ball-Squeezing and Motion-Artifact Induction Tasks
Multi-distance fNIRS recordings from 12 healthy adults performing a resting-state task, ball-squeezing tasks, and a motion-artifact induction task.
## Authors
Shibo Zhou, De'Ja Rogers, David A. Boas, Meryem A. Yücel, Yuanyuan Gao
## Citation
Zhou, S., Rogers, D., Boas, D. A., Yücel, M. A., & Gao, Y. Multi-Distance fNIRS Dataset Generated During Ball-Squeezing and Motion-Artifact Induction Tasks. OpenNeuro. [Dataset] doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds007420.v1.0.5
## License
CC0
## Participants
12 healthy young adults (6 female, 6 male; 23.2 ± 5.2 years; range 18–37 years).
## Acknowledgements
This work was supported by the NIH BRAIN Initiative (Grant No. 1U01EB029856-01). We thank all the participants and research staff involved in the data collection and analysis.
